title: Banjo rather than guitar when he started
summary: Everyone played banjo when Verrett was young, and music stores stocked the best banjos.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: I was going to ask about when you came up, but was everybody playing banjo rather than guitar?
When? When I came out of the Army?
No, I mean, when you started in music, when you were young, even.

Oh, when I started, that's what they're playing. That's why I like it. Everybody was playing? Yeah, it was banjo. No guitar, it was banjo, see? Everywhere you go, it was banjo, I mean, and they was playing. That's why I said, well, I want to take banjo, and banjo's selling me. I mean, all the music stores, they're putting the best stuff, they have material in the banjo.
